# Best of Chengdu
> A locally curated guide to Chengdu's finest food, hidden attractions, authentic experiences, and everything you need for an unforgettable trip to Sichuan's capital.

## Essential Pages
- [Home](https://best-of-chengdu.com/): Discover the best of Chengdu — a complete local travel guide with food, pandas, photo spots, and itinerary planning.
- [Best Food](https://best-of-chengdu.com/food/): Chengdu's iconic dishes, from hotpot to street snacks (UNESCO City of Gastronomy).
- [Best Attractions](https://best-of-chengdu.com/attractions/): Panda Base, top sights, and day trips from Chengdu.
- [Best Experiences](https://best-of-chengdu.com/experiences/): Sichuan opera, tea houses, nightlife, and local culture.
- [Travel Guide](https://best-of-chengdu.com/travel/): Best time to visit, where to stay, and getting around Chengdu.

## Detailed Guides
- [Best Hotpot in Chengdu](https://best-of-chengdu.com/food/hotpot/): 5+ recommended hotpot restaurants, how to eat, what to order.
- [Chengdu Panda Base Guide](https://best-of-chengdu.com/attractions/panda-base/): Tickets, best times, walking routes, baby panda season, Chengdu vs Dujiangyan comparison.
- [Best Sichuan Restaurants](https://best-of-chengdu.com/food/sichuan-restaurants/): From fine dining to family-run legends across Chengdu.
- [Best Day Trips from Chengdu](https://best-of-chengdu.com/attractions/day-trips/): Leshan Buddha, Mount Qingcheng, and more.
- [Best Hotels in Chengdu](https://best-of-chengdu.com/travel/hotels/): Neighborhood guide and budget picks.
- [Getting Around Chengdu](https://best-of-chengdu.com/travel/transportation/): Metro, buses, taxis, and bike sharing.
- [Best Time to Visit Chengdu](https://best-of-chengdu.com/travel/best-time-to-visit/): Seasonal weather and crowd guide.

## Blog Posts
- [Chengdu 3-Day Itinerary](https://best-of-chengdu.com/blog/chengdu-3-day-itinerary/): The perfect first visit plan with rainy-day and family alternatives.
- [Chengdu Food Guide for First-Timers](https://best-of-chengdu.com/blog/chengdu-food-guide-first-timers/): 12 must-try dishes, how to order, spice survival guide.
